app.tagline: Five places in Hawaiʻi. Where are you?
welcome.title: Pick a player name
welcome.body: No account. Just a name for the boards.
name.bad_chars: Letters, numbers, spaces, and ʻ . _ - only.
name.reserved: That name isn't allowed. Try another one.
name.profane: That name isn't allowed. Try another one.
name.invalid: That name isn't allowed. Try another one.
tutorial.card1: You get 5 places in Hawaiʻi each day.
tutorial.card2: Drag to turn and look around. You can't move, so look closely.
tutorial.card3: Open the map and drop your pin where you think you are.
tutorial.card4: The closer you are, the more points. Up to 5,000 a round.
coach.pin: Tap the map to drop your pin
coach.done: That's it. Now play for real.
home.offline: No connection. Today's set will load when you're back online.
round.title: Round {n} of 5
round.lock_hint: Tap the map to drop a pin
round.search_hint: Type a place to drop your pin there
round.error: No connection. Your round is saved. Try again when you're back online.
reveal.no_pin: No pin, no points this round
summary.title: Today's results
board.title: Leaderboard
board.empty: Nobody has finished yet. Be the first.
board.report_body: Three reports hide a name until it's reviewed.
board.error: Couldn't load the board. Pull to try again.
stats.title: Stats
stats.empty: Play a daily to start your stats.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Player name
settings.only_unplayed: Only remind me if I haven't played yet
settings.notif_denied: Reminders are off in system settings. Open Settings, Notifications, Kilo to turn them on.

settings.hawaiian_names.text: Hawaiian place names on the map

settings.privacy_body: Kilo stores your player name, a random id, your guesses, and your scores. Nothing else. No email, no location permission, no ads, no tracking.
settings.delete_confirm: This removes your name and every score from the boards. There's no undo.
about.title: About

about.body.text: Kilo drops you somewhere in Hawaiʻi five times a day and asks one thing: where are you? It's a small way to celebrate ʻāina, learn place names, and have fun every day.

practice.title: Practice
practice.body: Endless rounds. Not on the boards.
practice.missing: Practice pack missing. Reinstall the app or update it.
notif.morning1: Today's 5 spots are up. Where do you think they are?
notif.morning2: New day, new places. Your 5 are ready.
